description: Search the UMD campus directory for people by last name (prefix; "Pin*" wildcards work), full name, email address, Directory ID or phone number. No login needed for faculty, staff and affiliates (at most 50 results); after login students are included and up to 100 are returned.

query.description: Last name, full name, email, Directory ID or phone number, e.g. "Pines"

sounds_like.description: Also match last names that sound like the query, e.g. "Pynes" for Pines

name: directory_search

limit_reached.description: true when the directory capped the results (50 anonymously, 100 signed in); narrow the search to see the rest

message.description: Notice the directory showed instead of results, e.g. "No users found"; null otherwise

people.description: Matching people in the order the directory lists them

address.description: Office address lines (building, street, city); empty if not published

directory_id.description: UMD Directory ID (local part of a @umd.edu email); null for other institutions

email.description: Email address; null if not published

name.description: Full name as listed, e.g. "Darryll J Pines"

phone.description: Work phone, e.g. "+1 301 405 5803"; null if none

title.description: Job title, e.g. "Research Scientist"; null if none

title: Search the directory
